# mxstermind

> mxstermind.com is a premium bespoke design and development studio for established businesses, complex products, and operators who have outgrown fixed packages.

## Who we serve
- Established businesses needing senior capacity without agency overhead
- Founders with multi-surface products (web, mobile, automation, AI)
- Teams that want diagnosis before build — not template packages

## How to engage
Apply via Discord (https://discord.gg/a8Nz2R6M55) or Telegram (https://t.me/Notmxstermind). Scoped intake — no package checkout.

## Package tier (sister brand)
Fixed USD packages for faster launches: https://brandforge.gg/packages/
